title.zh: Intel Stock Suffers Worst Crash in 50 Years as Weak Forecast Overshadows AI Chip Demand
title.en: Intel Stock Suffers Worst Crash in 50 Years as Weak Forecast Overshadows AI Chip Demand

current_state.zh: Intel shares fell nearly 30% to $65.76 — its worst one-day drop in more than 50 years — after Q4 revenue guidance of $15-16B and EPS of $0.25 badly missed estimates, wiping out over $146 billion in market value even as AI server chip demand stays strong but is constrained by manufacturing and packaging shortages.
